basic_details.job_title: GMC Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 5 Lab Assistant Cum DEO, Research Scientist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Multi-Disciplinary Research Unit (MRU) at Government Medical College, Mahabubnagar (Government of Telangana) is filling 5 posts on contract basis for one year: Research Scientist-II (Scientist-‘C’), Research Scientist-I (Scientist ‘B’), Lab Technician (2 posts) and Lab Assistant Cum DEO (Grade ‘A’). The pay is Rs. 67,000/- + HRA, Rs. 56,000/- + HRA, Rs. 20,000/- + HRA and Rs. 20,000/- (Consolidated) a month respectively. Applications go in person or by speed post to the Office of the Director from 09-11-2026, 11.00 am until 13-11-2026, 5.00 pm, and eligible candidates are interviewed on 18

how_to_apply: Applications are offline only. The notice gives these steps:
Get the notification and application form from the Govt. Medical College, Mahabubnagar website (gmcmbnr-ts.org).
Fill in the application form and sign it. Applications not signed by the candidate are liable to be rejected.
Attach a non-refundable demand draft drawn from any nationalized bank in favour of "COLLEGE DEVELOPMENT SOCIETY GOVT MEDICAL COLLEGE MBNR": Scientist Rs. 1000/-, Others Rs. 500/-.
Submit the application in person or by speed post to: Office of the Director, Govt. Medical College, Mahabubnagar - 509302.
Submit from 09-11-2026, 11.00 am, on or before 13-11-2026 by 5.00 pm, on working days only. Applications will not be accepted after the last date and time.
Candidates applying for both posts must submit separate application forms with separate DDs.
Demand draft for the application fee
All original certificates, to be brought at the time of interview
important_instructions: Making any recommendations or references will be an irrevocable disqualification over all the merits of candidates. The notice/selection may be cancelled without any prior intimation on administrative grounds. If false information or suppression of any material information in the application form comes to notice at any time during service, the service would be liable to be terminated.

content_sections.heading: About GMC Mahabubnagar
content_sections.text: Government Medical College, Mahabubnagar is a Government of Telangana medical college in Mahabubnagar. The posts are in its Multi-Disciplinary Research Unit (MRU) and work under the control of the Director, Govt. Medical College, Mahabubnagar. The notice is signed by the Nodal Officer, Multi-Disciplinary Research Unit, and the Director, Government Medical College, Mahabubnagar. The posts are restricted only to the MRU at Govt. Medical College, Mahabubnagar.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 5 posts across four designations. It gives no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice calls the essential qualifications below mandatory. Desirable qualifications are not required to apply. The notice also says: "Reference will be given to the candidates having highest medical qualification." The age limit is not specified in the notice. Essential qualification: MD/DNB in Biochemistry/Microbiology from NMC recognized Medical College or Institute with two (2) Years research experience (OR) M.Sc, Ph.D in Biochemistry/Microbiology/Genetics or equivalent with 2 yrs experience in R&D with knowledge and experience in Bioinformatics and sequencing technology. Desirable: Experience in ICMR/DHR/IDSP/CSIR/DBT/any other project/Medical college Publication in indexed journals Knowledge of Computer Application/Data Management Essential qualification: M.Sc, Ph.D in Biochemistry/Microbiology/Genetics from a Recognized University WITH Research Experience of (2) years. Desirable: Experience in ICMR/DHR/IDSP/CSIR/DBT/any other project/Medical college Publication in indexed journals Knowledge of Computer Application/Data Management Essential qualification: B. Sc in Life Sciences or B. Sc in Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT) from a Recognized University. Desirable: Laboratory experience with all technical skills including Biochemical techniques work experience with UV-Visible spectrophotometer, ELISA, Molecular biology techniques PCR, and RT-PCR Experience in Histopathology and IHC Essential qualification: 12th pass in Science subjects or 2 Years Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT) with Computer technical qualification or B. Sc in Computer science from a recognized University. Desirable: Experience maintain laboratory stock entry records & laboratory cleanliness protocols. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: HRA is paid on top of the monthly remuneration for Research Scientist-II, Research Scientist-I and Lab Technician. The Lab Assistant Cum DEO post carries a consolidated Rs. 20,000/-. The notice does not mention the HRA amount or rate. All posts are recruited on contract basis only for one year, which may be extended based on performance and sanction of funds. The posts will not be considered as permanent at any point of time. Pension/GPF/PF/Leave Benefits will not be applicable. The selected staff will be eligible for fifteen (15) days leave in a calendar year. The contract may be terminated at any point of time if the performance is not satisfactory, with 1 week notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMC Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are offline only. The notice gives these steps: Get the notification and application form from the Govt. Medical College, Mahabubnagar website (gmcmbnr-ts.org). Fill in the application form and sign it. Applications not signed by the candidate are liable to be rejected. Attach all the necessary documents. Attach a non-refundable demand draft drawn from any nationalized bank in favour of "COLLEGE DEVELOPMENT SOCIETY GOVT MEDICAL COLLEGE MBNR": Scientist Rs. 1000/-, Others Rs. 500/-. Submit the application in person or by speed post to: Office of the Director, Govt. Medical College, Mahabubnagar - 509302. Submit from 09-11-2026, 11.00 am, on or before 13-11-2026 by 5.00 pm, on working days only. Applications will not be accepted after the last date and time. Candidates applying for both posts must submit separate application forms with separate DDs. Filled and signed application form All the necessary documents Demand draft for the application fee All original certificates, to be brought at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be done as per the guidelines of the Department of Health Research (DHR), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India. After scrutinising the applications received, eligible candidates will be called for interview. List of eligible candidates: to be displayed on 17-11-2026. Interview of eligible candidates: 18-11-2026. The notice does not give the interview venue or time. Candidates must bring all original certificates at the time of interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending interviews.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Any changes in the scheduled dates will be notified on the college website.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GMC Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 posts: 1 Research Scientist-II (Scientist-‘C’), 1 Research Scientist-I (Scientist ‘B’), 2 Lab Technician and 1 Lab Assistant Cum DEO (Grade ‘A’) in the MRU.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted on or before 13-11-2026 by 5.00 pm; submission opens on 09-11-2026 at 11.00 am, on working days only.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: B. Sc in Life Sciences or B. Sc in Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT) from a Recognized University is the essential qualification for Lab Technician.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the GMC Mahabubnagar MRU posts?
faq.answer: Research Scientist-II gets Rs. 67,000/- + HRA, Research Scientist-I Rs. 56,000/- + HRA, Lab Technician Rs. 20,000/- + HRA and Lab Assistant Cum DEO Rs. 20,000/- (Consolidated) per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is added to the pay of Research Scientist-II, Research Scientist-I and Lab Technician, while the Lab Assistant Cum DEO pay of Rs. 20,000/- is consolidated.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000/- for Scientist and Rs. 500/- for Others, paid by a non-refundable demand draft in favour of "COLLEGE DEVELOPMENT SOCIETY GOVT MEDICAL COLLEGE MBNR" from any nationalized bank.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for GMC Mahabubnagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the filled, signed form with documents and the DD in person or by speed post to the Office of the Director, Govt. Medical College, Mahabubnagar - 509302.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised, the list of eligible candidates is displayed on 17-11-2026, and eligible candidates are interviewed on 18-11-2026, as per DHR guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the posts are on contract for one year, which may be extended based on performance and sanction of funds, and will not be considered permanent at any point of time.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates applying for both posts must submit separate application forms with separate DDs.
